correctness.rationale: Reconstructed graph from F2^4 and five XOR generators; proved strongly regular parameters (16,5,0,2) and absence of 4-edge distinct-generator relations, so all 4-cycles use two generators twice. First-uncovered-vertex recursion exhausts each 8-edge perfect matching uniquely; independent count=705. One 4-cycle flip corresponds exactly to symmetric difference of four graph edges between two perfect matchings; independent all-pairs computation gives 2160 undirected edges and degree counts {4:200,6:360,8:60,10:80,16:5}. Exhaustive BFS from every one of 705 states gives connectedness, radius7/diameter8 and complete pair histogram including 8840 at distance8. The 16 translations and all 120 permutations of the five generators yield 1920 automorphisms; any vertex-fixing automorphism is determined by its five neighbors (every other vertex the unique nonzero common neighbor of a pair), giving full group. Explicit orbit action yields 7 orbits and confirms the 5 centers exactly coincide with the 5 parallel direction matchings. Independent newly written combinatorial verifier with alternate matching representation, all-pairs BFS and group action reproduced the result. This is exhaustive finite proof, not a sample or merely a successful verifier log.
residual_risks: This is exact finite classification of one graph, not a general theorem for all folded cubes or a mixing-time bound.
The count of 705 matchings and some prescribed-direction multiplicities are prior published facts, not credited as new.

value.rationale: The 5-regular Clebsch graph is a canonical highly symmetric small graph; its perfect-matching local flip dynamics are natural in combinatorial reconfiguration. The exact radius, diameter, geodesic centers, complete distance histogram and seven orbits are a coherent natural full finite classification useful as a benchmark for switch-chain algorithms and future folded-cube questions. The five central parallel matchings and orbit splits supply nontrivial structural information beyond 705 matchings.
residual_risks: No mixing-time/Hamiltonicity or higher-folded-cube theorem follows automatically; relevance is a finite exact canonical test case.

final_claim: The 4-cycle-flip graph of all perfect matchings of the 5-regular Clebsch graph C on F_2^4 with generating XOR directions {1,2,4,8,15} has 705 vertices, 2160 edges, connected diameter 8 and radius 7, with exactly five eccentricity-7 direction-parallel centers; all other 700 have eccentricity 8. Its 705 matchings form exactly seven Aut(C) orbits of sizes 5,80,60,120,240,160,40, with a complete degree/distance histogram and 8840 pairs at distance eight.
